meta.title: January in Da Nang: A Surprisingly Beautiful Beach Walk
meta.description:
Today I’m out for another surprising beach walk in Da Nang, Vietnam, right in the middle of January.
Even though it’s supposed to be the rainy season, the weather once again changed quickly, and I talk about what it’s really like on the ground instead of just trusting the forecast.
During this walk, I share my live commentary about:
The current January weather in Da Nang
How unpredictable the rainy season really is
What the beach atmosphere feels like today
How busy it is with locals and tourists
My honest thoughts while walking along My An / My Khe Beach
This is a real-time walking and talking tour, no script, no filters — just honest impressions and updates from Da Nang in 2026.
If you’re planning to visit Da Nang in January, already living here, or just enjoy authentic travel commentary, this video gives you a realistic look at the beach and weather today.
Thanks for walking with me — if you enjoy these live commentary walks, consider liking the video and subscribing for more Da Nang updates 🌴🇻🇳
